method.id_hash: FNV-1(lower-case name): offset 0x811C9DC5, prime 0x01000193, XOR then multiply - reproduces 118/118 event ids in AUDIO_MAP.json
method.rtpc_layout: u16 count before the list; entry = u32 param_id, u8 type (0), u8 interpolation, u8 a, u32 curve_id, u8 b, u16 point_count, then point_count * (f32 x, f32 y, u32 curve_type)
rtpc_anchors: u16 before the chain == number of entries that parse
no param_id is a HIRC object id
the BML_Steering parameters resolve to the AkParameterName list
method.lufs: ITU-R BS.1770-4: K-weighting biquads at 48 kHz, 400 ms blocks with 75% overlap, -70 LUFS absolute gate and -10 LU relative gate; channels weight 1.0

loop_field_probe.note: Sound body bytes 4..8 (plugin type, 0, codec id, 0, stream type) do not separate looping from one-shot events (8 vs 32 rows probed), so the Wwise loop bit is not pinned here - per-event loop evidence is the `Stop_` counterpart, the name tokens and any vgmstream loop lines

groups.name: movement
groups.note: jump and dodge one-shots (JUMP_LAND / PREJUMP / PRELAND / WIND, DODGE)

groups.name: afterburner
groups.note: RocketTails only; no separate boost bed is an event in these packages

groups.name: winch
groups.note: no AkEvent in the grab plays Winch audio (the BML_Winch parameters ship, the events do not)

groups.name: emp
groups.note: no AkEvent in the grab is an EMP sound

groups.name: horn
groups.note: no horn event ships in these packages - the only `Beep` events are tank lock-on UI

groups.name: other
groups.note: rows no rule matched: rain, world objects, the Batwing line
